clips.title: The story
paras: This errand marks the formal induction of a capable operative into the ranks of the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken order of assassins and spies. Tasked with delivering Andron's Ledger directly to the dreadlord Varimathras, the courier brings proof of the Syndicate's covert activities to the highest tier of Undercity leadership.

After unearthing incriminating records from Andron Gant, Mennet Carkad officially welcomes the operative into the Deathstalkers. The organization serves as Lady Sylvanas's eyes, ears, and daggers throughout Lordaeron, relying on intelligence networks, ruthless efficiency, and stealth to eliminate threats before they surface. Gaining formal recognition within the order is a major milestone for any aspiring rogue or scout in the Undercity.

Because of the sensitive nature of the intelligence, the ledger is delivered directly to Varimathras in the Royal Quarter of the Undercity. The nathrezim commander oversees Forsaken tactical intelligence under Sylvanas Windrunner. Pleased with the Deathstalkers' initiative, Varimathras welcomes the operative's demonstrated capability, noting that his intelligence division can always make use of someone who delivers results.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Syndicate? I would never have suspected. It seems the lords of Alterac have fallen far in the years since their betrayal.
Lord Varimathras will be pleased to learn of this, and as you were so instrumental in this discovery, it would be fitting if you were the one to deliver it to him.
Ah, and how could I forget?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm, this is interesting. The Deathstalkers have performed their duties admirably in ferreting this out.
From what I understand, you also deserve commendation for your performance. I hope that this will become routine for you, friend, my Deathstalkers always have use of a good man.
